name: google-cloud-cli

resources.checksum_source: local SHA-256 pin after official HTTPS download
local SHA-256 pin after official versioned snapshot download

notes: Converts the official sdk.cloud.google.com bootstrap and its install_google_cloud_sdk.bash child. Both hosted originals are fetched at build time with pinned SHA-256 values. Only minimal call anchors are published for these bootstrap stages; changed bytes require reanalysis.

The bootstrap download selects the official complete versioned Linux x86_64 archive instead of the seed archive that would fetch components online. Preserves extraction, overwrite rejection, the archive install.sh and its unmodified Python initialization, official PATH updates and Bash completion.

The full archive includes Python 3.14.9, bq and gsutil. No system Python or pip download is needed. The versioned official components-v592.0.0.json is bundled and supplied through the native component_manager/snapshot_url file:// override for installer component listing.

Normal installation retains the upstream refusal to overwrite an existing google-cloud-sdk directory. Explicit --reinitialize verifies the exact installed version and reruns the official archive installer for repeat initialization; it does not delete an existing installation.

Tests bundled Python ssl/sqlite3, gcloud/bq/gsutil versions, offline component listing, local project/logging configuration, and official profile/completion activation. Cloud login, API requests and extra components are outside scope.

Ubuntu 22.04 x86_64 glibc test baseline. The archived Google Cloud CLI LICENSE declares Apache-2.0 unless an alternate license applies; its included Python and third-party dependency notices remain in the original archive.
